thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: To generate all permutations of a given list of distinct integers, we can use a backtracking approach. Starting from each element, we explore all possible permutations by swapping the current element with other elements and recursively generating permutations for the remaining elements. Once we reach the end of the list, we add the current permutation to the result.
